prompt: Order the body of the recursive merge sort helper: stop on 0 or 1 items, sort each half, merge the halves into `tmp`, then copy the result back. One line does not belong.
lines: merge_sorted(a, mid, a + mid, n - mid, tmp);
distractors: merge_sorted(a, mid, a + mid, n - mid, a);
explain: Sort the left half, sort the right half, then merge them into the scratch array `tmp` and copy back. Merging straight into `a` would overwrite items that have not been read yet.
